headline: India announces 1.62 billion dollar economic package for flood hit Nepal
label: NEWS
caption:
India announced a massive 1.62 billion dollar economic package to help flood hit Nepal recover and rebuild.

According to Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi, the 240 billion Nepalese rupees package aims to support reconstruction and long term development after devastating Himalayan floods in August.

Speaking in New Delhi alongside Nepali Prime Minister Balendra Shah, Modi stated that the commitment will help affected families and strengthen disaster resilience.

Prime Minister Shah thanked India for acting as a first responder and invited Indian investors to partner in economic prosperity.

Would this financial aid significantly improve bilateral ties between the two neighbors? 👇
